synopsis.text: A group of strangers takes shelter in a Pennsylvania farmhouse as the dead return to life. Outside, the threat keeps growing. Inside, nobody agrees on how to survive.

context.text: A cemetery visit turns uneasy as Johnny teases Barbra among the gravestones.

trivia.text: A missing copyright notice sent the original film into the public domain.

rights.note: Original 1968 black-and-white release; source edition from Internet Archive.
